description_expanded: Overview5.0(18 reviews) WATERCOLOR – Second Wind Beautiful Home in the Camp District | Sleeps 8 DESCRIPTION Second Wind is a stunning Watercolor home located in the highly sought-after Camp District. With its spacious design, this professionally decorated home is just a block from Camp Watercolor and steps away from tennis courts. The home offers the perfect combination of modern amenities, coastal charm, and easy access to the best of Watercolor. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax on the large screened-in porch, enjoy the porch swing, or dine al fresco with serene views. This home also includes 4 bikes for use during your stay. The WaterColor Beach Club is nearby, providing easy beach access and pools. HOME FEATURES ✔ 3 bedrooms | 2 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 8 ✔ Gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, gas range, separate ice maker, and beverage cooler ✔ Spacious screened-in porch with outdoor seating and swing ✔ 4 bikes for guest use ✔ Cozy coastal design with beautiful, soothing tones throughout ✔ Smart TVs, and WiFi DINING & ENTERTAINMENT ✔ Access to WaterColor Beach Club with pools, dining, and drinks at WaterColor Grill and Costa Chica ✔ Access to Camp Watercolor’s lazy river, zero-entry pool, and The Canteen dining WHY STAY HERE? ✔ Spacious, family-friendly design with room for everyone ✔ Perfect location near the best of WaterColor’s amenities and beaches ✔ A beautifully designed home offering comfort, style, and relaxation SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS ✔ 1 King bedrooms ✔ 1 Queen bedroom ✔ 1 room with two twin bunk beds Second Wind is the ideal place to unwind, offering everything you need for an unforgettable Watercolor experience.Show less
